class="uma-news-ribbon"><span>In the Works</span></div> <details class="uma-card"> <summary> <span class="uma-meta"><span class="uma-pill">Lorebooks</span><span class="uma-date">2026/08/18 02:47 (UTC)</span></span> <span class="uma-card-txt">@uma_enjoyer's journey of his passion project, Umamusume Lorebooks. BETA &#8594; FV14</span> <span class="uma-card-go">&#187;&#187;</span> </summary> <div class="uma-cbody"> <p>The Umamusume Lorebooks. My passion project, made for everyone to enjoy chatting with the utmost quality and accuracy with Umamusume characters. It took months of updating, testing and experimenting, and it is still in progress, in the hope that it becomes one of the best publicly created lorebooks for chat bots.</p> <span class="uma-schip"><i class="uma-dot"></i>In progress</span> </div> </details> <details class="uma-card"> <summary> <span class="uma-meta"><span class="uma-pill">Debut</span><span class="uma-date">2026/11/20 01:00 (UTC)</span></span> <span class="uma-card-txt">The introduction to saucepan.ai, a 250 follower special.</span> <span class="uma-card-go">&#187;&#187;</span> </summary> <div class="uma-cbody"> <p>Being mainly a Janitor AI bot creator, with old experience from older platforms, joining the <a href="https://saucepan.ai/u/uma_enjoyer">saucepan.ai</a> community is a solid step away from Janitor AI's original character definition format. I found myself overwhelmed when I first looked at it, but ultimately I preferred it, because it gives me much more freedom to fine tune the character card.</p> </div> </details> <details class="uma-card"> <summary> <span class="uma-meta"><span class="uma-pill">Production</span><span class="uma-date">2026/10/30 11:12 (UTC)</span></span> <span class="uma-card-txt">The shift from quality over quantity.</span> <span class="uma-card-go">&#187;&#187;</span> </summary> <div class="uma-cbody"> <p>I am moving away from <i>only</i> making Umamusume bots. I want to branch out into new fandoms, try fresh ideas, and introduce my work to different communities. With that, the January 2027 Lorebooks release target is being pushed back to <b>February or March 2027</b>. Looking at the math, finishing by January meant updating each lorebook in just a week and a half. I have put way too much effort into these lorebooks to rush them now, so taking a bit more time is definitely the right move.</p> </div> </details> <details class="uma-card"> <summary> <span class="uma-meta"><span class="uma-pill">Schedule</span><span class="uma-date">2026/11/07 01:34 (UTC)</span></span> <span class="uma-card-txt">What @uma_enjoyer's schedule in bot creation looks like.</span> <span class="uma-card-go">&#187;&#187;</span> </summary> <div class="uma-cbody"> <p>My character cards will usually be released on weekends. During the week I am usually off thinking up scenarios and experimenting with lorebook prototypes that may be used for the next update of my passion project. Expect probably like 2 to 4 bots a week. It would commonly be 2, that is what I have to trade in order to get higher quality creations. 4 is when I have excess free time. Pick your time zone below and it opens with my schedules.</p> <div class="uma-tzlist"> <details class="uma-tz"> <summary>UTC-08 &middot; LOS ANGELES (WINTER)</summary> <div class="uma-tz-body"> <div class="uma-tz-slot"><span class="uma-tz-lbl">Weekend A</span><span class="uma-tz-time">5:00 PM to 7:00 PM</span></div> <div class="uma-tz-slot"><span class="uma-tz-lbl">Weekend B</span><span class="uma-tz-time">4:30 AM to 7:00 AM</span></div> </div> </details> <details class="uma-tz"> <summary>UTC-07 &middot; uma-tag-white"><span>About Me</span></div></div> <div class="uma-about-ph"> <div class="uma-tc-port"> <img class="uma-tc-pfp" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lanzopanzo2013-eng/puppeteer@9c867618abe4b16f7a7a976fb589e7aceedcea73/uma-profile/assets/site/pfp.jpg"> </div> <div class="uma-tc-body"> <span class="uma-tc-role"><i>@uma_enjoyer</i></span> <div class="uma-tc-name">Fuji/Aki</div> <div class="uma-tc-fol"><span>Followers</span><b>128,043</b></div> <img class="uma-tc-break" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lanzopanzo2013-eng/puppeteer@071c6ccac752ace2c0d8a19a4b5ecfa6d3cffdd8/uma-profile/assets/site/horseshoe-break.png"> <div class="uma-tc-bio"> <p>Hi reader, I am uma_enjoyer, and you can call me <strong>Fuji or Aki</strong>. I started creating bots back in 2023, focusing on realistic Japanese life scenarios all the way to <strong>Initial D</strong>, then in spring I stopped and switched to Janitor AI, and by August 2026 I was making story-first Umamusume bots.</p> <p>As a person I am male, he/him, <strong>half Filipino and half Japanese</strong>, and I speak three languages. They are English, Tagalog and Japanese, though my vocabulary is just okay in all of them. I do motorsports in real life and on the simulator, and I am a professional in the sport. I am a young adult who still does college classes, I am single, and I take life seriously to the fullest.</p> <img class="uma-tc-break" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lanzopanzo2013-eng/puppeteer@071c6ccac752ace2c0d8a19a4b5ecfa6d3cffdd8/uma-profile/assets/site/horseshoe-break.png"> <p>I love cars a lot, like, really. Almost <strong>70%</strong> of the fun in my whole life comes from the car life, and that is thanks to my dad. When I was an elementary/middle schooler he was a well-known member of a car club and always took me around car meets and track days. It is unfortunate that he passed away, just recently, but for my family's privacy I won't go deeper than that. I compete in a lot of motorsport competitions, and no, I am not a rich kid who wants to race. <strong>The wins pay for my entrance fees.</strong></p> <p>AI is another thing I find highly interesting. I love experimenting with LLMs, I would consider myself a great prompter, and I could see myself having a job related to AI someday too. I love cats, and dogs too, and I don't hate any kind of housepet at all. I used to play <strong>War Thunder and Call of Duty</strong> all the time during COVID, so I am capable of creating military-themed bots. I love the world of desktops too, so if you want to discuss PC parts, I can happily take part.</p> <p>I believe in God, but I will not specify which God because of privacy reasons, and on that note I keep my identity private so I don't get known for this in real life. In bot creation I specialize in <strong>lorebooks, RPG and Japan life scenarios</strong>. I can create any kind of bot, although I am weak when it comes to smut and I don't have much experience with it, so if you are a smut-focused person, I am not for you to like.</p> <img class="uma-tc-break" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lanzopanzo2013-eng/puppeteer@071c6ccac752ace2c0d8a19a4b5ecfa6d3cffdd8/uma-profile/assets/site/horseshoe-break.png"> <p>Oh, and I do love horse racing too. One of my notable events was spectating from the grandstands at the <strong>Arima Kinen, 2022</strong>. I got myself a QR ticket and I watched <strong>Equinox</strong> win. To be fair I am not that passionate about it compared to cars, but I still have some passion for horse racing.</p> <p>And then there is Umamusume. I first watched season 1 because my friends invited me to watch with them, then I played <strong>Umamusume Pretty Derby</strong> by March 2021. I was not a try-hard at the game, I only played it lightly until now to be honest, and I think that is going to be the same forever, although I did watch all the anime series Umamusume has to offer, which strengthened my passion for these horsegirls.</p> </div> </div> <div class="uma-about-figs" aria-hidden="true"> <img class="fig-jet" alt="" width="34" height="22" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lanzopanzo2013-eng/puppeteer@003d995/uma-profile/assets/site/fig-jet.png"> <img class="fig-car" alt="" width="51" height="22"
